portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
X.org X11 is an open source implementation of the X Window System. It
provides the basic low-level functionality that full-fledged graphical user
interfaces (GUIs) such as GNOME and KDE are designed upon.

The following issues have been addressed in this update:
-- A memory leak in the X server related to Xcursor
-- A memory leak in the vesa video driver
-- Issues when DRI is enabled on some Radeon 7000 hardware
-- Excessive debug messages emitted by the i915 DRI driver
-- A XKB support regression in the Xnest X server
-- Several issues that affected ATI video hardware based on the RN50
   chipset, such as the ES1000 have been resolved in the "radeon" driver.

The following features have been added in this update:
-- Support for the Matrox G200SE chipset has been added to the mga driver.  
   A late report indicates there is a problem at high resolutions, however, 
   which can be worked around by using DacSpeed "65" in the X server config 
   file.
-- xkbdata support added for Sun Type6 keyboards
-- PCI-E support added for HP ZX2 (ia64)

Users should upgrade to these updated packages, which resolve these issues.
